title: KMS Fall Meeting 2026: Presentations and a Poster Award
subtitle: Four student posters, a special-session talk, and Hojin Ko's Outstanding Poster Award.

sections.text: MLFE Lab participated in the 2026 Korean Mathematical Society (KMS) Fall Meeting, held at Gwangju Institute of Science and Technology (GIST) from October 29 to 31. Jeonggyu Huh gave a special-session talk, and Hojin Ko, Yoonyoung Byun, Dongwan Shin, and Seungho Na presented posters.
sections.html: MLFE Lab participated in the 2026 Korean Mathematical Society (KMS) Fall Meeting, held at Gwangju Institute of Science and Technology (GIST) from October 29 to 31. Jeonggyu Huh gave a special-session talk, and Hojin Ko, Yoonyoung Byun, Dongwan Shin, and Seungho Na presented posters.

sections.text: Hojin Ko received an Outstanding Poster Award for “Knowing When Not to Act: Latent No-Action Region Recovery Hidden in Neural Control” and gave a presentation on his award-winning poster. Congratulations to Hojin and to all our student presenters! 👏
